section: Race summaries > Round 7 – Canada Circuit Gilles Villeneuve

entities.name: Lewis Hamilton
entities.description: Hamilton won the race, becoming the seventh winner in seven races and taking a two-point lead in the championship.

entities.name: Fernando Alonso
entities.description: Alonso's tyres lost all grip and he fell victim to Hamilton.

entities.name: Romain Grosjean
entities.description: Grosjean finished second in the race.

entities.name: Sebastian Vettel
entities.description: Vettel passed Alonso in quick succession.

entities.name: Jenson Button
entities.description: Button finished sixteenth in what he described as his 'worst race in years'.

entities.name: Lotus
entities.description: Lotus took third place in the Constructors' Championship from Ferrari.
